text:
Maya (Design): flagging a small but annoying discoverability issue in trace viewer: when header collapses on narrow screens the export action disappears into the overflow and folks can't find it. Thinking we should move export actions into the drilldown kebab and surface an "Export options" modal.
Kevin (Product): saw support case where correlation_id was missing in the CSV. that's high-impact for analytics customers.
Sam (Eng runtime): backend does include correlation_id, but we strip it for "compact" exports. we can expose a checkbox to keep them.
Maya (Design): sketch: radio group Compact vs Full, checkbox "Include correlation IDs and span metadata", and a tiny preview area showing first 2-3 columns so column ordering expectations are clear. default: Compact for self-serve, Full for paid.
Aisha (Accessibility): important: the checkbox needs a descriptive aria-label not just "Include". suggestion: aria-label="Include correlation IDs and span metadata in export". Also the preview needs an accessible text alternative.
Sam (Eng runtime): implementation note: column ordering changed between Compact and Full and broke a customer's ingestion script. we should offer a stable_column_order=true API flag and a preview to reduce surprises.
Kevin (Product): agree. also add telemetry: export_started with export_type and include_correlation flags, and triggered_from=kebab|header to track discoverability.
Aisha (Accessibility): keyboard focus order must be logical: modal content -> preview -> radios -> checkbox -> export -> cancel. export button should get aria-describedby when a filesize warning appears.
Maya (Design): visual: current mock has low contrast on primary. use brand primary #0055AA and a 3px focus ring. include copy: Compact — "summary CSV (fewer columns, faster)"; Full — "complete trace export (includes correlation and span-level data)".
Sam (Eng runtime): large exports can be huge. propose threshold 10MB: show warning "Large export (>10MB). We'll email you a download when ready" and offer async delivery rather than blocking the UI.
Kevin (Product): can we keep a one-click Quick CSV for tiny traces (<1MB)? Good for power users.
Maya (Design): yes: show Quick CSV when trace small, otherwise show Export options. copy for quick: "Quick CSV — immediate, compact columns".
deploy-bot: ui:trace-export v2 deployed to staging at 1712470150.
Sam (Eng runtime): tested on staging: modal opens, preview renders, checkbox persisted session-only. bug: preview didn't include correlation_id even when checked; backend fix in flight.
Aisha (Accessibility): small SR nit — announce shortcut (E) via aria-live when focused; add tooltip for discoverability.
Maya (Design): action items: Sam to wire corr IDs and stable_column_order API + filesize async path; Aisha to draft final aria labels and warning text; Kevin to add telemetry and API ticket. reconvene in 48hrs for sign-off. :thumbsup:
